title: Official Metadata Addon AV ThePornDB Hash Lookup
compatibility_policy: Breaking internal architecture is allowed, but new public hash alias names must be documented.
decision: Use provider-owned external-id aliases file_oshash and file_phash for this slice; defer MetadataQuery.file_hashes until multi-hash arrays are needed.
closeout_summary: Added ThePornDB scene hash lookup through file_oshash/file_phash aliases, calling /scenes/hash/{hash} with OSHASH/PHASH, mapping returned hash rows, documenting usage, and verifying with targeted/full package gates.
follow_ups: Add MetadataQuery.file_hashes for provider-neutral multi-hash arrays.
Add ThePornDB movie hash lookup once scene/movie intent is explicit.
